integrity: The upper bound is a self-contained permutation-group argument using pair-orbit valencies, semiregularity of the centralizer, and Sylow counting; the lower bound is the published D_m construction. A degree-18 transitive-group census provides a finite sanity check but is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem covers orders n congruent to 2 modulo 4; the cases with 2-adic valuation at least 2 remain outside its scope.
The originality assessment cannot exclude unpublished folklore or a result hidden under different permutation-group terminology.
The finite degree-18 census is supporting evidence only; the infinite family is proved symbolically.
title: Exact distance maximum for every 1-homogeneous metric space of order 4k+2
